D.t: Aaron Ford leads by 2.1 in the forecast and wins 65% of simulations. The cushion is about 26,136 votes; a one point swing is about 6,164 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +5.4 and D +9.7. A normal polling error decides it.
The polls page average is R +3.0. Your best recent poll is Noble Predictive Insights at R +2.5; your worst is Global Strategy Group for Ford (D) at R +3.5. 2 polls in the last 30 days.
The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Clark, a projected net 87,436 votes; Washoe, a projected net 4,453 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
The large counties within 12 points: Clark, D +10.3, 68.9% of the vote; Washoe, D +2.0, 18.0% of the vote; Carson City, R +11.5, 2.2% of the vote.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Aaron Ford runs furthest behind in Douglas, Lyon, Elko. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: Large counties, 87% of voters, 53 to 44, where a 5 point gain is worth 4.35 points; Voters without a degree, 67% of voters, 50 to 47, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.33 points; White voters, 66% of voters, 41 to 56, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.31 points.

The forecast's worst groups for Aaron Ford: Immigration voters 22 to 74, Small counties 27 to 68, Voters who can afford daily costs 38 to 58. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
